title: Pure Iron Chain
summary: Iron Chain is Warden Armstrong's punishing 5D's strategy focusing on deck destruction, burn damage, and EARTH Synchro recursion. Iron Chain Repairman revives Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil from the graveyard every turn with no effect negation, immediately tuning into the 2500 ATK Iron Chain Dragon. As Iron Chain Dragon mills the opponent's Deck with every hit, Poison Chain and Paralyzing Chain steadily deplete the opponent's cards and Life Points, backed by Naturia Beast and Naturia Barkion for total spell and trap denial.

allow.Crane Crane: Level 3 EARTH monster that revives Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil from your GY on Normal Summon to immediately Synchro Summon Level 6 Iron Chain Dragon.
allow.Psychic Wheeleder: Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 3 monster and pops an opponent's monster on Synchro Summon.
allow.Psychic Tracker: Level 3 EARTH Psychic that Special Summons itself while you control a Level 3 monster and grants +600 ATK to the Synchro Monster.
allow.Paralyzing Chain: Continuous Spell that burns for 300 damage every time cards are sent from the opponent's Deck to the GY by a card effect.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil to the GY so Iron Chain Repairman can immediately revive it.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Iron Chain Repairman or Iron Chain Blaster.
allow.Naturia Barkion: Level 6 EARTH Dragon Synchro made with Level 3 EARTH Tuner Iron Chain Coil + Level 3 non-Tuner that banishes 2 cards from GY to negate Trap activations.
allow.Naturia Beast: Level 5 EARTH Beast Synchro made with Level 3 Coil + Level 2 Blaster that mills 2 cards to negate Spell activations.
allow.Goyo Guardian: Level 6 EARTH Warrior Synchro that steals monsters destroyed by battle.
allow.The Phantom Knights of Break Sword: Rank 3 Xyz made with two Level 3 monsters that destroys a card on each field.
allow.Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier: Level 6 Synchro that discards cards to bounce opposing cards back to hand.
allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 Synchro Tuner that destroys a card and draws 1 card when sent to GY.

main: Iron Chain Repairman
Core Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1600 ATK): inflicts 300 burn damage when destroying a monster by battle, and once per turn Special Summons ANY Level 4 or lower 'Iron Chain' monster from your GY!
Iron Chain Coil
Core Level 3 EARTH Machine Tuner: once per turn targets 1 'Iron Chain' monster you control to permanently grant it +300 ATK/DEF, and tunes with Level 3s into Level 6 Iron Chain Dragon.
Iron Chain Snake

Level 3 EARTH Reptile: equips itself to an opponent's monster during your Main Phase to reduce its ATK/DEF by 800; when that monster is destroyed by battle, mills cards from the opponent's Deck equal to its Level!
Iron Chain Blaster
Level 2 EARTH Warrior: tributes 1 'Iron Chain' monster you control to inflict 800 burn damage to your opponent, and tunes with Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil for Level 5 Naturia Beast.
Crane Crane
Level 3 EARTH monster that revives Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil or Iron Chain Snake from your GY upon Normal Summon for an instant Level 6 Synchro or Rank 3 Xyz.
Psychic Wheeleder
Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control Level 3 Iron Chain Coil or Iron Chain Snake to make Level 6 Synchros.
Psychic Tracker
Level 3 EARTH Psychic extender that Special Summons itself while you control a Level 3 monster.
Poison Chain

Archetypal Continuous Spell: during each of your End Phases, if you did not declare an attack, forces your opponent to send cards from the top of their Deck to the GY equal to the number of face-up 'Iron Chain' monsters you control.
Paralyzing Chain
Continuous Spell: every time a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY by a card effect, inflicts 300 burn damage to your opponent!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Iron Chain Coil from Deck to GY so Iron Chain Repairman or Crane Crane can immediately revive it.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Iron Chain Repairman.
extra: Signature Level 6 EARTH Dragon Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners; 2500 ATK): banishes all 'Iron Chain' monsters from your GY to gain +200 ATK for each, and sends the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck to the GY every time it inflicts battle damage!
